title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Venetian Bronze | Waverly Place | Allied Brass | Bathroom Vanity Shelf Organizer | Allied Brass
description:
Running out of room at the sink? This wall-mounted glass shelf creates storage above the vanity while the integrated towel bar keeps a hand towel within reach in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Pairs elegantly with matching Waverly Place hardware for refined warmth
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Choose enduring hardware made from solid brass
- Coordinate transitional bath accessories with the Waverly Place Collection for matching Waverly Place pieces and a cohesive look

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Wall mount glass shelf / bathroom vanity shelf with towel bar
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall projection: 5 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available
